name: Veganzones (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red saltire, charged at the crossing with a yellow crown of an infanzón.
history: The arms and flag of Veganzones were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 16 September 1997; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a yellow cloth with a red saltire and a yellow infanzón's crown at its intersection.

features.role: crown of an infanzón at the crossing
